$L = $maxLen;

// build automaton states: all suffixes of words
$stateId = [];
$states = [];
$stateId[""] = 0;
$states[] = "";
$queue = [""];
while ($queue) {
    $cur = array_pop($queue);
    foreach ($words as $w) {
        $len = strlen($w);
        for ($k = 1; $k <= $len; $k++) {
            $suf = substr($w, $len - $k);
            if (!isset($stateId[$suf])) {
                $stateId[$suf] = count($states);
                $states[] = $suf;
                $queue[] = $suf;
            }
        }
    }
}
$S = count($states);

// transitions and word-end flags
$trans = array_fill(0, $S, array_fill(0, 26, 0));
$isEnd = array_fill(0, $S, false);
$wordLen = array_fill(0, $S, 0);

for ($i = 0; $i < $S; $i++) {
    $s = $states[$i];
    foreach ($words as $w) {
        if ($s === $w) {

    for ($c = 0; $c < 26; $c++) {

        $len = strlen($ns);
        for ($k = 1; $k <= min($len, $L); $k++) {
            $sub = substr($ns, $len - $k);
            if (isset($stateId[$sub])) {
                $best = $sub;
                break;
            }
        }
        if ($best === "") $best = "";
        $trans[$i][$c] = $stateId[$best];
    }

// We need count of strings and segmentations; but easier: build matrix over states

$M = array_fill(0, $dim, array_fill(0, $dim, 0));
for ($i = 0; $i < $S; $i++) {
    for ($c = 0; $c < 26; $c++) {
        $j = $trans[$i][$c];
        $M[$j][$i] = ($M[$j][$i] + 1) % MOD;
    }

// we need sequences where positions are fully covered by segments (words).
// That means we count paths where every position belongs to some word.
// This is equivalent to counting all strings where automaton visits end states possibly overlapping,
// but segments are contiguous words: any occurrence of word end can be segment boundary.
// For a single hint, any string over dictionary words concatenation is valid.
// That is just all strings generated by concatenating words: a regular language.
// Build DP over length using word lengths only.

$maxWordLen = $L;
$dp = array_fill(0, $maxWordLen, 0);

        if ($i >= $len) {

        $len = strlen($w);
        if ($i == $len) {
            $coef[$i] = ($coef[$i] + 1) % MOD;
        }

// compute f(m): number of strings for one hint
function matMul($A, $B) {
    $n = count($A);
    $res = array_fill(0, $n, array_fill(0, $n, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        for ($k = 0; $k < $n; $k++) {
            if ($A[$i][$k] == 0) continue;
            $val = $A[$i][$k];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $n; $j++) {
                if ($B[$k][$j] == 0) continue;
                $res[$i][$j] = ($res[$i][$j] + $val * $B[$k][$j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return $res;
}

function matPowVec($coef, $init, $m) {
    $k = count($coef);
    if ($m < $k) return $init[$m];
    $size = $k;
    $T = array_fill(0, $size, array_fill(0, $size, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) {
        $T[0][$i] = $coef[$i];
    }
    for ($i = 1; $i < $size; $i++) {
        $T[$i][$i - 1] = 1;
    }
    $e = $m - ($k - 1);
    $res = array_fill(0, $size, array_fill(0, $size, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) $res[$i][$i] = 1;
    $base = $T;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = matMul($base, $res);
        $base = matMul($base, $base);
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    $vec = array_reverse($init);
    $ans = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) {
        $ans = ($ans + $res[0][$i] * $vec[$i]) % MOD;
    }
    return $ans;
}

$init = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $k; $i++) $init[] = $dp[$i];
$f_m = matPowVec($coef, $init, $m);

// total instances: for each string counted by f(m), two hints independently: f(m)^2
$ans = ($f_m * $f_m) % MOD;
echo $ans . PHP_EOL;

const MOD = 998244353;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$words = [];
$maxLen = 0;

    $w = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $words[] = $w;
    $maxLen = max($maxLen, strlen($w));
}

$L = $maxLen;

$next = [];
$isEnd = [];
$next[0] = array_fill(0, 26, -1);
$isEnd[0] = 0;
$nodeCnt = 1;

    $cur = 0;
    $len = strlen($w);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $c = ord($w[$i]) - 97;
        if ($next[$cur][$c] == -1) {
            $next[$cur][$c] = $nodeCnt;
            $next[$nodeCnt] = array_fill(0, 26, -1);
            $isEnd[$nodeCnt] = 0;
            $nodeCnt++;
        }
        $cur = $next[$cur][$c];
    }
    $isEnd[$cur] = 1;
}

// precompute transitions for lengths 1..L
$trans = array_fill(0, $nodeCnt, array_fill(0, $L + 1, []));
for ($u = 0; $u < $nodeCnt; $u++) {
    for ($len = 1; $len <= $L; $len++) {
        $res = [];
        for ($c = 0; $c < 26; $c++) {
            $v = $next[$u][$c];
            if ($v == -1) continue;
            $res[] = $v;
        }
        $trans[$u][$len] = $res;
    }
}

// dpWords[len][u] = number of words of length len ending at node u
$dpWords = array_fill(0, $L + 1, array_fill(0, $nodeCnt, 0));
foreach ($words as $w) {
    $len = strlen($w);
    $cur = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $c = ord($w[$i]) - 97;
        $cur = $next[$cur][$c];
    }
    $dpWords[$len][$cur] = 1;
}

// count ways to form strings of length len with segmentation into dictionary words
// dpSeg[len] = number of ways
$dpSeg = array_fill(0, $L, 0);
$dpSeg[0] = 1;
for ($len = 1; $len <= $L; $len++) {
    $sum = 0;
    foreach ($words as $w) {
        $wl = strlen($w);
        if ($wl > $len) continue;
        $sum += $dpSeg[$len - $wl];
        if ($sum >= MOD) $sum -= MOD;
    }
    $dpSeg[$len] = $sum;
}

// number of strings of length len that are concatenation of words
$cntStr = $dpSeg;

// number of pairs of segmentations (top,bottom) for given string length len
// This is (cntStr[len])^2
$cntPairs = array_fill(0, $L, 0);
for ($len = 1; $len <= $L; $len++) {
    $cntPairs[$len] = (int)(($cntStr[$len] * 1LL * $cntStr[$len]) % MOD);
}

// For length > L, recurrence is linear with constant coefficients depending on words lengths
// We can model number of segmentations as linear recurrence with maxLen L
// dpSeg[n] = sum over words w of dpSeg[n - |w|]
// This is linear recurrence of order L with coefficients c[k] = number of words of length k
$c = array_fill(1, $L, 0);
foreach ($words as $w) {
    $wl = strlen($w);
    $c[$wl]++;
}

// Build initial vector for dpSeg: S[0..L-1]
$S = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $L; $i++) $S[$i] = $dpSeg[$i];

// function to multiply two polynomials modulo MOD with truncation degree L
function polyMul($a, $b, $L) {
    $res = array_fill(0, $L, 0);
    $na = count($a);
    $nb = count($b);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $na; $i++) {
        if ($a[$i] == 0) continue;
        for ($j = 0; $j < $nb && $i + $j < $L; $j++) {
            if ($b[$j] == 0) continue;
            $res[$i + $j] = ($res[$i + $j] + $a[$i] * 1LL * $b[$j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return $res;
}

// binary exponentiation of recurrence using Kitamasa-like method for dpSeg and then square for pairs
function kthTerm($k, $L, $c, $S) {
    if ($k < $L) return $S[$k];
    $k -= ($L - 1);
    $base = array_fill(0, $L, 0);
    $base[1] = 1;
    $res = array_fill(0, $L, 0);
    $res[0] = 1;
    while ($k > 0) {
        if ($k & 1) $res = polyMul($res, $base, $L);
        $base = polyMul($base, $base, $L);
        $k >>= 1;
    }
    $ans = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $L; $i++) {
        $coef = ($i == 0) ? $c[1] : $c[$i + 1];
        if ($coef == 0) continue;
        $ans = ($ans + $res[$i] * 1LL * $S[$L - 1 - $i]) % MOD;
    }
    return $ans;
}

if ($m <= $L) {
    $ans = $cntPairs[$m];
} else {
    $seg = kthTerm($m, $L, $c, $S);
    $ans = (int)($seg * 1LL * $seg % MOD);
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;

<?php
const MOD = 998244353;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$words = [];
$maxLen = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $w = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $words[] = $w;
    $maxLen = max($maxLen, strlen($w));
}

$L = $maxLen;

// build alphabet from words
$alphaSet = [];
foreach ($words as $w) {
    $len = strlen($w);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $alphaSet[$w[$i]] = true;
    }
}
$alphabet = array_keys($alphaSet);
sort($alphabet);
$K = count($alphabet);
$char2id = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $K; $i++) $char2id[$alphabet[$i]] = $i;

// build trie
$next = [];
$term = [];
$next[0] = array_fill(0, $K, -1);
$term[0] = false;
$nodeCnt = 1;

foreach ($words as $w) {
    $cur = 0;
    $len = strlen($w);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
        $c = $char2id[$w[$i]];
        if ($next[$cur][$c] == -1) {
            $next[$cur][$c] = $nodeCnt;
            $next[$nodeCnt] = array_fill(0, $K, -1);
            $term[$nodeCnt] = false;
            $nodeCnt++;
        }
        $cur = $next[$cur][$c];
    }
    $term[$cur] = true;
}

// build automaton states: (node, len)
$stateId = [];
$states = [];
$stateCnt = 0;
for ($node = 0; $node < $nodeCnt; $node++) {
    for ($len = 0; $len <= $L; $len++) {
        $stateId[$node][$len] = $stateCnt;
        $states[$stateCnt] = [$node, $len];
        $stateCnt++;
    }
}

// transitions
$trans = array_fill(0, $stateCnt, array_fill(0, $K, 0));
for ($sid = 0; $sid < $stateCnt; $sid++) {
    [$node, $len] = $states[$sid];
    for ($c = 0; $c < $K; $c++) {
        $node2 = $next[$node][$c];
        if ($node2 == -1) {
            // no word prefix, invalid; but we still need a state.
            // We'll create a dead state (0,0) effectively by mapping to root with len=0.
            $trans[$sid][$c] = $stateId[0][0];
            continue;
        }
        $len2 = $len + 1;
        if ($len2 > $L) $len2 = $L; // cap, though shouldn't exceed
        if ($term[$node2]) $len2 = 0;
        $trans[$sid][$c] = $stateId[$node2][$len2];
    }
}

// build matrix for pair automaton
$S = $stateCnt;
$dim = $S * $S;
$M = array_fill(0, $dim, array_fill(0, $dim, 0));

for ($s1 = 0; $s1 < $S; $s1++) {
    for ($s2 = 0; $s2 < $S; $s2++) {
        $from = $s1 * $S + $s2;
        for ($c = 0; $c < $K; $c++) {
            $t1 = $trans[$s1][$c];
            $t2 = $trans[$s2][$c];
            $to = $t1 * $S + $t2;
            $M[$from][$to]++;
            if ($M[$from][$to] >= MOD) $M[$from][$to] -= MOD;
        }
    }
}

function matMul($A, $B) {
    $n = count($A);
    $C = array_fill(0, $n, array_fill(0, $n, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        for ($k = 0; $k < $n; $k++) {
            if ($A[$i][$k] == 0) continue;
            $aik = $A[$i][$k];
            $rowB = $B[$k];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $n; $j++) {
                if ($rowB[$j] == 0) continue;
                $C[$i][$j] = ($C[$i][$j] + $aik * $rowB[$j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return $C;
}

function matPow($M, $e) {
    $n = count($M);
    $R = array_fill(0, $n, array_fill(0, $n, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) $R[$i][$i] = 1;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $R = matMul($R, $M);
        $M = matMul($M, $M);
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $R;
}

$dimMat = $dim;
$Mpow = matPow($M, $m);

// initial state (root,0),(root,0)
$start = $stateId[0][0] * $S + $stateId[0][0];
$ans = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $dimMat; $i++) {
    $ans = ($ans + $Mpow[$start][$i]) % MOD;
}
echo $ans . PHP_EOL;

    $len = strlen($w);

        $c = ord($w[$i]) - 97;

$stateId = [];
function getStateId($a, $b, $ma, $mb, &$states, &$stateId) {

        $id = count($states);
        $stateId[$key] = $id;
        $states[] = [$a, $b, $ma, $mb];

        $nb = $trans[$b][$c];
        $nma = $ma;
        $nmb = $mb;
        foreach ($wordTrans[$a][$c] as $widx) {

// Matrix exponentiation (sparse)
function matMul($A, $B, $n) {
    $C = array_fill(0, $n, []);

        foreach ($rowA as $k => $vA) {
            if (!isset($B[$k])) continue;
            foreach ($B[$k] as $j => $vB) {
                $val = (int)(($vA * $vB) % MOD);

                if (!isset($C[$i][$j])) $C[$i][$j] = 0;
                $C[$i][$j] += $val;
                if ($C[$i][$j] >= MOD) $C[$i][$j] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return $C;
}

        foreach ($row as $j => $v) {
            $sum += $v * $vec[$j];

    return $res;

// This is independent of actual letters because dictionary fixed.
// So we just count compositions of t with parts in lengths of words, but words distinguished.

$cntLen = array_fill(1, $L, 0);

// Let f[m] = sum_{l=1..L} dp2[l] * f[m-l], with f[0]=1.
// We need f[m]. Use linear rec via binary exponentiation (Kitamasa).

$coef = array_fill(1, $L, 0);

<?php
const MOD = 998244353;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$words = [];
$maxLen = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $w = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $words[] = $w;
    $maxLen = max($maxLen, strlen($w));
}

$L = $maxLen;

// build automaton states: all substrings of words up to length L
$stateId = [];
$states = [];
$stateId[""] = 0;
$states[0] = "";
$cntStates = 1;

foreach ($words as $w) {
    $len = strlen($w);
    for ($start = 0; $start < $len; $start++) {
        $s = "";
        for ($k = $start; $k < $len && $k - $start + 1 <= $L; $k++) {
            $s .= $w[$k];
            if (!isset($stateId[$s])) {
                $stateId[$s] = $cntStates;
                $states[$cntStates] = $s;
                $cntStates++;
            }
        }
    }
}

$S = $cntStates;

// transitions and word-end flags
$trans = array_fill(0, $S, array_fill(0, 26, 0));
$isWordEnd = array_fill(0, $S, false);

$dictSet = [];
foreach ($words as $w) $dictSet[$w] = true;

for ($i = 0; $i < $S; $i++) {
    $s = $states[$i];
    if (isset($dictSet[$s])) $isWordEnd[$i] = true;
    for ($c = 0; $c < 26; $c++) {
        $ch = chr(ord('a') + $c);
        $ns = $s . $ch;
        if (strlen($ns) > $L) $ns = substr($ns, -$L);
        while ($ns !== "" && !isset($stateId[$ns])) {
            $ns = substr($ns, 1);
        }
        if ($ns === "") $nid = 0;
        else $nid = $stateId[$ns];
        $trans[$i][$c] = $nid;
    }
}

// DP for one hint: number of ways to cover length m
// states: automaton state, and whether we are at word boundary (i.e., last segment ended here)
$dim = $S * 2;

// build transition matrix for one step
$M = array_fill(0, $dim, array_fill(0, $dim, 0));

for ($st = 0; $st < $S; $st++) {
    for ($b = 0; $b < 2; $b++) {
        $from = $st * 2 + $b;
        for ($c = 0; $c < 26; $c++) {
            $nst = $trans[$st][$c];
            $nb = $b;
            if ($isWordEnd[$nst]) $nb = 1;
            $to = $nst * 2 + $nb;
            $M[$to][$from] = ($M[$to][$from] + 1) % MOD;
        }
    }
}

// initial vector: state 0, boundary=1 (we can start a word)
$vec = array_fill(0, $dim, 0);
$vec[0 * 2 + 1] = 1;

// fast exponentiation of matrix M to power m, applied to vec
function matMul($A, $B) {
    $n = count($A);
    $m = count($B[0]);
    $k = count($B);
    $res = array_fill(0, $n, array_fill(0, $m, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        for ($t = 0; $t < $k; $t++) {
            if ($A[$i][$t] == 0) continue;
            $a = $A[$i][$t];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
                if ($B[$t][$j] == 0) continue;
                $res[$i][$j] = ($res[$i][$j] + $a * $B[$t][$j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return $res;
}

function matVecMul($M, $v) {
    $n = count($M);
    $k = count($v);
    $res = array_fill(0, $n, 0);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        $sum = 0;
        for ($j = 0; $j < $k; $j++) {
            if ($M[$i][$j] == 0 || $v[$j] == 0) continue;
            $sum = ($sum + $M[$i][$j] * $v[$j]) % MOD;
        }
        $res[$i] = $sum;
    }
    return $res;
}

function matPowVec($M, $power, $vec) {
    $n = count($M);
    // identity matrix
    $resM = array_fill(0, $n, array_fill(0, $n, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) $resM[$i][$i] = 1;
    $base = $M;
    while ($power > 0) {
        if ($power & 1) $resM = matMul($base, $resM);
        $base = matMul($base, $base);
        $power >>= 1;
    }
    return matVecMul($resM, $vec);
}

$vecM = matPowVec($M, $m, $vec);

// valid endings: boundary=1 (last segment ended exactly at position m)
$waysOne = 0;
for ($st = 0; $st < $S; $st++) {
    $waysOne = ($waysOne + $vecM[$st * 2 + 1]) % MOD;
}

// total chainwords: two independent hints over same string
// number of strings counted in waysOne; for each string, hints1 and hints2 independent
$ans = ($waysOne * $waysOne) % MOD;
echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>
